programme.title: The Nutty Professor

programme.title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World
programme.desc: Spencer Tracy leads a hilariously zany cast of Hollywood's greatest comedians (including Milton Berle, Sid Caesar, Ethel Merman and Mickey Rooney) as eight vacation-bound motorists set off on a mad-cap, side-splitting race to find a stolen fortune!

programme.title: Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: Café busboy Walter ventures into the world of sculpting with a small statue called Dead Cat. Unfortunately, Dead Cat is followed by Murdered Man. By the time we reach Walter’s interest in the female form...well, you get the picture.

programme.title: Scared Stiff (1953)
programme.desc: Fleeing from a murder charge, Dean Martin and Jerry Lewis find gangsters and ghosts on a spooky Caribbean island inherited by an heiress.

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: Despite trying to keep his swashbuckling to a minimum, a threat to California's pending statehood causes the adventure-loving Alejandro de la Vega (Banderas) - and his wife, Elena (Zeta-Jones) - to take action.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam, and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death.”

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to have revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: When four teenagers all meet with mysterious deaths exactly one week after watching a videotape, investigative reporter Rachel Keller tracks down the video... and watches it.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: Rings
programme.desc: When a college professor discovers the video rumored to kill viewers 7 days after watching, he and his students try to unlock the secrets of the Samara legend. But when the video goes viral, they must find a way to defeat Samara before it's too late.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Juwanna Mann
programme.desc: A basketball star is booted out of the NBA when his on-court antics go too far, so he poses as a woman and joins the WUBA. Rated PG-13

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: Quinn, a member of a SWAT unit, steps out of a park fountain in an Asian city with no recollection of who he is or where he came from. As he pieces together clues from his past, he vaguely recalls his young daughter, who has been kidnapped.

programme.title: Triple Threat
programme.desc: This breakneck thriller teams over half a dozen of the world’s biggest action stars for the martial arts event film of the year. When a hit is taken out on a billionaire’s daughter, it’s mercenaries versus assassins in an all-out war.

programme.title: Avengement
programme.desc: While released on furlough from prison, a lowly criminal evades his guards and returns to his old haunts to take revenge on the people that made him a cold-hearted killer.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical yet gratuitous cameos from thrillers, blockbusters, and pop culture in general, getting its best goosing yet.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: The all-star cast returns to pull serious spoofs of The Grudge, Saw, War of the Worlds, and The Village. While her house is haunted by a little boy, Cindy is determined to find out who killed him and why.

programme.title: Death Defying Acts
programme.desc: On a tour of Britain in 1926, Harry Houdini enters into a passionate affair with a psychic out to con the famous magician.

programme.title: The Brothers Bloom
programme.desc: The con is on when two swindlers (Adrien Brody, Mark Ruffalo) make an heiress (Rachel Weisz) the target of their next scheme.

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Anne Hathaway stars in an unforgettable, modern fairy tale in which a girl's given the gift of obedience by her Fairy Godmother. An amazing, magical adventure bursting with colorful characters, music, wit, and whimsy.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Enough
programme.desc: An abused wife on the run from her violent husband finally decides she's had enough.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: Unforgettable and powerful, this winner of 9 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Director (Anthony Minghella) and Best Supporting Actress (Juliette Binoche) unfolds an incredible tale of passion, intrigue, and adventure.

programme.title: The Soloist
programme.desc: A Los Angeles newspaper reporter discovers a brilliant and distracted street musician, with unsinkable passion, and a unique friendship and bond transforms both their lives.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: This one-of-a-kind musical biopic embarks on the spectacular journey of Elton John in his rise to fame. With incredible performances of Elton's most beloved songs, discover how a small-town boy became one of the most iconic figures in rock & roll.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: A woman asks her ex-lover for help in order to save her outlaw husband from a gang out to kill him.

programme.title: The Homesman
programme.desc: Tommy Lee Jones stars in “the best western since UNFORGIVEN” (BBC). A low-life drifter helps a headstrong woman (Hilary Swank) cross the frontier after she rescues him from hanging.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Mallrats
programme.desc: Two loafers who spend way too much time at the mall try to win back their girlfriends with the help of the ultimate delinquents, Silent Bob and Jay.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, 19-year-old Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse - "it" is following her, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 4
programme.desc: Katie disappeared with her nephew, Hunter, and there were no survivors. Five years later, she's returned with a mysterious boy, ready to target new victims with her demonic rage in a quiet neighborhood.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Marked Ones
programme.desc: The activity is back and has claimed a new victim. Jesse has been hearing horrifying sounds from his neighbor’s apartment, but when he sets out to uncover their source, he encounters an ancient evil that won’t rest until it’s claimed his soul.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: For the first time, you will SEE the activity... When a new family moves into a familiar house, they discover a mysterious video camera that reveals a demonic threat and soon find themselves terrorized by an ancient evil.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part II
programme.desc: Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.

programme.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
programme.desc: Ignoring Camp Crystal Lake’s bloody legacy, one by one they fall victim to the maniacal Jason who stalks them at every turn...

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: Want someone to infiltrate a top-secret organization or steal a scientific formula that could change the world? For the right price, The Saint is your man.

programme.title: Domestic Disturbance
programme.desc: In this “edge of your seat thriller,” John Travolta stars as Frank Morrison, a man who discovers that his son’s new stepfather (Vince Vaughn) is not who he pretends to be.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger

programme.title: Scared Stiff (1953)
programme.desc: Fleeing from a murder charge, Dean Martin and Jerry Lewis find gangsters and ghosts on a spooky Caribbean island inherited by an heiress.

programme.title: The War of the Worlds (1953)
programme.desc: Gene Barry and Ann Robinson are among the humans intrigued when a meteor-like object crashes to Earth … but its occupants are definitely not friendly.

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programme.desc: The survivor of a space expedition claims his crew was killed by an alien creature. The rescue captain dismisses the explanation only to find that a creature has stowed away on the spacecraft and begins to hunt the human hosts.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam, and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death.”

programme.title: Kill Bill: Vol 1
programme.desc: The Bride wakes up after a long coma. The baby that she carried before entering the coma is gone. The only thing on her mind is to have revenge on the assassination team that betrayed her - a team she was once part of.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: When evidence at a local crime scene reveals a mysterious unmarked videotape, Rachel realizes that Samara is back and more determined than ever to continue her relentless cycle of terror.

programme.title: Rings
programme.desc: When a college professor discovers the video rumored to kill viewers 7 days after watching, he and his students try to unlock the secrets of the Samara legend. But when the video goes viral, they must find a way to defeat Samara before it's too late.

programme.title: Quarantine
programme.desc: When a news crew decides to trail a brave fire-fighting team, they never suspect that the first call for help they respond to that night may be their last. Now they're trapped in an apartment complex sealed off by the government. Rating: R

programme.title: Juwanna Mann
programme.desc: A basketball star is booted out of the NBA when his on-court antics go too far, so he poses as a woman and joins the WUBA. Rated PG-13

programme.title: The Nutty Professor (1996)
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy gives "the performances" of his career -- playing seven roles! -- in this hilarious comedy about a genetics professor who experiments with his own fat-reducing serum.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!

programme.title: Avengement
programme.desc: While released on furlough from prison, a lowly criminal evades his guards and returns to his old haunts to take revenge on the people that made him a cold-hearted killer.

programme.title: Lights Out
programme.desc: A drifting ex-soldier turns underground fighter with the help of a just-released ex-con, pitting them both against corrupt cops and hired killers gunning for them and all those they care about.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: The all-star cast returns to pull serious spoofs of The Grudge, Saw, War of the Worlds, and The Village. While her house is haunted by a little boy, Cindy is determined to find out who killed him and why.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Home with their newly-formed family, happy parents Dan and Jody are haunted by sinister, paranormal activities — disrupting new mama Jody’s dancing aspirations in the “Swan Lake” ballet and threatening Dan’s rise as an ape researcher.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Anne Hathaway stars in an unforgettable, modern fairy tale in which a girl's given the gift of obedience by her Fairy Godmother. An amazing, magical adventure bursting with colorful characters, music, wit, and whimsy.

programme.title: What's Love Got to Do With It?
programme.desc: In London, an award-winning filmmaker documents her best friend's journey into an arranged marriage in line with his family's Pakistani heritage. In the process, she challenges her own attitude towards relationships.

programme.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Frankenstein's monster becomes involved in a war between two immortal clans.

programme.title: Rocketman
programme.desc: This one-of-a-kind musical biopic embarks on the spectacular journey of Elton John in his rise to fame. With incredible performances of Elton's most beloved songs, discover how a small-town boy became one of the most iconic figures in rock & roll.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: A Neo-Western thriller set in the American Southwest, following Sheriff Hickey as he tries to solve the worst case he has seen in his small town, likely committed by a violent local gang led by a fearsome criminal.

programme.title: The Brothers Grimm
programme.desc: In this visionary film, Will and Jake Grimm dazzle small towns with their imaginative folklore and elaborate illusions, only to discover that many of the fantastic characters and thrilling situations from their beloved fairy tales are real.

programme.title: Fun Size
programme.desc: Wren is a hip girl whose plans to attend the high school event of the year ends when she has to babysit her brother. When he disappears, Wren must set out to find him before her mom discovers he's missing.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, 19-year-old Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse - "it" is following her, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: For the first time, you will SEE the activity... When a new family moves into a familiar house, they discover a mysterious video camera that reveals a demonic threat and soon find themselves terrorized by an ancient evil.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: Art The Clown sets his sights on three young women, along with anyone else that gets in his way.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
programme.desc: This time, he seems to have set his sights on the young patients at a secluded halfway house. And more than a few of his teen targets end up in half, in quarters... You name it, Jason does it.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programme.desc: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity lands Slevin into the middle of a war being plotted by two of the city's most rival crime bosses: The Rabbi and The Boss.

programme.title: Road to Perdition
programme.desc: Bonds of loyalty are put to the test when a hitman's son witnesses what his father does for a living.

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Jim Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) is a professor leading a double life as a high-stakes gambler. When he borrows money from dangerous gangsters, he places the lives of his loved ones in mortal danger and must risk everything to keep from losing it all.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: Idle Hands
programme.desc: The devil will find work for idle hands to do, but what happens when he chooses the laziest teen slacker in the world to do his dirty work? Anton Tobias is a couch potato burnout who can't control the murderous impulses of his possessed hand. Rated: R

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Are you afraid to die? Kiefer Sutherland isn't. He's an ambitious, charismatic medical student who persuades his classmates, Julia Roberts and Kevin Bacon, to take part in a reckless experiment. Rated: R

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Harold and Maude
programme.desc: A classic cult film that features one of the screen's most unlikely pairs. It will defy everything you've ever seen or known about screen lovers.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: The Crow: Wicked Prayer
programme.desc: The fourth film in the dark superhero franchise is an epic new action tale. After an ex-con tries to straighten out his life, he and his girlfriend are brutally murdered by a renegade gang. A mysterious crow brings him back for revenge and redemption.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Visually stunning and action-packed, this hit movie, based on the comic book series, follows the return from the grave of a young rock guitarist who, along with his fiancée, is brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Little Nicky
programme.desc: When Satan reneges on his plans to retire, two of his three heirs leave Hell to gather enough souls to vote the Prince of Darkness out of office. But Satan sends his youngest—and nicest—son, Little Nicky, to bring the other two home.

programme.title: Mr. Deeds
programme.desc: Funnyman Adam Sandler stars in MR. DEEDS, the hilarious remake of the classic American comedy Mr. Deeds Goes to Town.

programme.title: The House Next Door: Meet the Blacks 2
programme.desc: Author Carl Black's life takes an unexpected turn when he meets the eccentric new homeowner next door. Convinced that the man is a vampire, Carl and his oddball neighbors join forces to save themselves from the bloodsucking undead.

programme.title: American Psycho
programme.desc: A mentally unhinged yuppie in the 1980s New York submits to an uncontrollable bloodlust.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: After a highly unusual zombie saves a still-living girl from an attack, the two form a relationship that sets in motion events that might transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: Things To Do In Denver When You're Dead
programme.desc: An ex-gangster (Andy Garcia) reassembles his old gang for one last job. When things go awry and someone gets killed, Jimmy and his partners are marked for death, leaving Jimmy 48 hours to make things right for his buddies and the woman of his dreams.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Deuces
programme.desc: An undercover cop finds himself drawn in by a unique, charismatic gang leader.

programme.title: Love Jones
programme.desc: In this sweet, comic romance set against the jazz rhythms of Chicago, two educated, upscale urban artists discover modern courtship as they both experience a Love Jones.

programme.title: Mooz-lum
programme.desc: Amid a strict Muslim rearing and a social life he's never had, Tariq enters college confused. New peers, family and mentors help him find his place, but the 9-11 attacks force him to face his past and make the biggest decisions of his life.

programme.title: Star Trek VIII: First Contact
programme.desc: They call themselves the Borg – a half-machine collective with a sole purpose: to conquer and assimilate all races.

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

programme.title: Star Trek X: Nemesis
programme.desc: Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. "This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Creed II
programme.desc: The next chapter in the Creed story follows Adonis Creed's life inside and outside the ring as he deals with newfound fame, family issues, and his ongoing quest to become a champion, with Michael B. Jordan and Sylvester Stallone starring.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: Rocky
programme.desc: As the boxer 'everyman' Rocky Balboa, Sylvester Stallone comes out swinging with heart, humor, and unforgettable power as he 'goes the distance' against World Heavyweight Champion Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) in this unforgettable, Oscar®- winning film!

programme.title: A Hip Hop Story
programme.desc: A pioneer of the culture joins forces with a few of rap music's elite performers to attempt to save hip hop.

programme.title: Friday
programme.desc: Before the sun sets, Craig must get his friend out of trouble, find a new job so his parents don't evict him, escape his girlfriend long enough to capture a new woman's heart, and survive a confrontation with the neighborhood menace.

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs and his lottery-winner uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: As a couple welcomes a newborn baby into their home, a demonic presence begins terrorizing them, tearing apart their perfect world and turning it into an inescapable nightmare.

programme.title: Vampires of the Velvet Lounge
programme.desc: A coven of vampires hunts on dating apps, meeting vampire hunters and scheduling dates. The nights that unfold are action-packed, modern-horror madness.

programme.title: X (2022)

programme.title: The Beast With A Million Eyes

programme.title: Invaders From Mars
programme.desc: In the early 1950s, Cold War tensions and the burgeoning space race created a heady mix of paranoia and unbridled creativity as filmmakers speculated as to the marvels - and horrors - that lay beyond the stars.

programme.title: Kill Bill: Volume 2
programme.desc: Writer-director Quentin Tarantino completes the quest for revenge started in KILL BILL: VOL. 1. The Bride (Uma Thurman) crosses the final names off her death list in KILL BILL: VOL. 2.

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: The machete-wielding federale returns in this sequel, which pits him against a maniacal arms dealer and a revolutionary in a violent battle.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam, and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death.”

programme.title: Quarantine
programme.desc: When a news crew decides to trail a brave fire-fighting team, they never suspect that the first call for help they respond to that night may be their last. Now they're trapped in an apartment complex sealed off by the government. Rating: R

programme.title: Quarantine 2: Terminal
programme.desc: Earlier tonight, a bizarre disease was unleashed in a run-down Los Angeles tenement... and no one got out alive. Yet something escaped. Now, aboard Flight 318, the first symptoms begin to show. Rating: R

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Two best friends finally realize that they may be in love with each other.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: Furie
programme.desc: When a little girl is kidnapped by a trafficking ring, they soon find they messed with the wrong child. Her mother, a notorious former gang leader, is close on their trail and will go to any lengths to bring her daughter home.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2
programme.desc: When his cover gets blown, a Hong Kong cop (Wu Jing) lands in a Thai prison where the warden works with a criminal mastermind (Louis Koo) to harvest organs.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical yet gratuitous cameos from thrillers, blockbusters, and pop culture in general, getting its best goosing yet.

programme.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.

programme.desc: In this musical adaptation of the hit 1983 film that changed American teenage life forever, Julie (Jessica Rothe) is the ultimate ‘80s Valley Girl, whose world is rocked when she falls hard for Randy (Josh Whitehouse), a punk rocker from Hollywood!

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Frankenstein's monster becomes involved in a war between two immortal clans.

programme.title: Joy Ride
programme.desc: When a psychotic trucker takes offense at the pranks pulled by a couple of college students, the young kids are sucked into a whirlpool of terror.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Rescue Dawn
programme.desc: In 1965, while bombing Laos, pilot Dieter Dengler crashes in the jungle. Dieter is arrested, tortured and sent to a prison camp, where he organizes an escape plan. A betrayal splits the group and Dieter finds that the jungle is the actual prison.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: A Neo-Western thriller set in the American Southwest, following Sheriff Hickey as he tries to solve the worst case he has seen in his small town, likely committed by a violent local gang led by a fearsome criminal.

programme.title: Forsaken (2014)
programme.desc: In 1872, an embittered gunslinger named John Henry Clayton attempts to make amends with his estranged father, Reverend Samuel Clayton, while their community is besieged by ruthless land-grabbers.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programme.desc: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
programme.desc: Ever since homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees got trapped in chains at the bottom of Crystal Lake, the nearby summer camp has operated without a hitch... without a murder. But one of this season’s happy campers has brought along a deadly secret.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
programme.desc: The Big Apple’s in big trouble, as indestructible psycho-fiend Jason Voorhees hits the road to New York City - and paints the town “red.”

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Jim Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) is a professor leading a double life as a high-stakes gambler. When he borrows money from dangerous gangsters, he places the lives of his loved ones in mortal danger and must risk everything to keep from losing it all.

programme.title: Righteous Kill
programme.desc: Two veteran New York City detectives (Academy-Award-winners Robert De Niro and Al Pacino) hunt a vigilante who may be one of their own.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America, along with the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Attack the Block
programme.desc: ATTACK THE BLOCK is a fast, funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen street gang against an invasion of savage alien monsters. It turns a crazy mix of tough street kids into a team of kick-ass heroes.

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Are you afraid to die? Kiefer Sutherland isn't. He's an ambitious, charismatic medical student who persuades his classmates, Julia Roberts and Kevin Bacon, to take part in a reckless experiment. Rated: R

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature. Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

programme.title: Double Team
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude Van Damme joins forces with NBA and media sensation Dennis Rodman in this action-packed thriller. Top counter-terrorist Jack Quinn is ready to get out of the spy game until the evil Stavros kidnaps his wife and unborn son.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur, along with his squire and his Knights of the Round Table.

programme.title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
programme.desc: A notorious religious satire, the film tells the story of Brian (Graham Chapman), a reluctant would-be messiah who rises to prominence as a result of a series of absurd and truly hilarious circumstances.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Visually stunning and action-packed, this hit movie, based on the comic book series, follows the return from the grave of a young rock guitarist who, along with his fiancée, is brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals.

programme.title: The Crow: City of Angels
programme.desc: This fast-moving, action-packed sequel to THE CROW follows the rise of murder victim Ashe Corven, brought back to life by a mysterious crow. With the help of a woman named Sarah, he exacts revenge on his killers one by one.

programme.title: Mr. Deeds
programme.desc: Funnyman Adam Sandler stars in MR. DEEDS, the hilarious remake of the classic American comedy Mr. Deeds Goes to Town.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: After a highly unusual zombie saves a still-living girl from an attack, the two form a relationship that sets in motion events that might transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: Borderlands
programme.desc: Returning to her home planet Pandora, an infamous bounty hunter forms an unexpected alliance with a ragtag team of misfits. Together, they battle alien monsters and dangerous bandits to uncover one of Pandora's most explosive secrets.

programme.title: The Blackening
programme.desc: A group of old college friends reunite for a Juneteenth weekend getaway, only to find themselves trapped in a remote cabin with a twisted killer. Forced to play by his rules, they soon realize this isn't a game.

programme.title: The House Next Door: Meet the Blacks 2
programme.desc: Author Carl Black's life takes an unexpected turn when he meets the eccentric new homeowner next door. Convinced that the man is a vampire, Carl and his oddball neighbors join forces to save themselves from the bloodsucking undead.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a married workaholic is given a universal remote that lets him pause, rewind, or skip past parts of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best.

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Mooz-lum
programme.desc: Amid a strict Muslim rearing and a social life he's never had, Tariq enters college confused. New peers, family and mentors help him find his place, but the 9-11 attacks force him to face his past and make the biggest decisions of his life.

programme.title: Butter (aka Never 2 Big)
programme.desc: Deceit, body heat and pulsing street beats converge in this explosive story about the music industry!

programme.title: Juice
programme.desc: Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

programme.title: Star Trek X: Nemesis
programme.desc: Set a course for a galaxy of unparalleled action and adventure as Captain Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) and his Starship crew battle a chilling new adversary…that happens to hold a shocking link to Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picard’s only hope for a future rests within the Nexus...and a legendary captain from the past.

programme.title: Star Trek VIII: First Contact
programme.desc: They call themselves the Borg – a half-machine collective with a sole purpose: to conquer and assimilate all races.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. "This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back and gain the freedom of his people in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Creed III
programme.desc: After dominating the boxing world, Adonis Creed has been thriving in his career and family life. But now he puts his future on the line to battle a fighter -- and former friend -- who has absolutely nothing to lose…and everything to gain.

programme.title: Rocky

programme.title: Rocky II
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Carl Weathers, and Burgess Meredith return for the rematch of the century as Rocky takes on Apollo Creed, even though his doctors advise against it, in this blockbuster sequel that brought audiences to their feet!

programme.title: Next Friday
programme.desc: A streetwise man flees South Central Los Angeles, heading to the suburbs and his lottery-winner uncle and cousin to avoid a neighborhood thug with a grudge who has escaped from prison. But trouble soon follows, and the suburbs will never be the same.

programme.title: Friday After Next
programme.desc: Craig and Day-Day have finally moved into their own apartment, but a ghetto grinch breaks in and steals all their Christmas presents—and the rent money. To avoid eviction before Christmas, the cousins take jobs as unarmed security guards at a strip mall.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Paranormal Activity
programme.desc: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic and active at night.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 2
programme.desc: As a couple welcomes a newborn baby into their home, a demonic presence begins terrorizing them, tearing apart their perfect world and turning it into an inescapable nightmare.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: Paranormal Activity 3 takes you back to where it all began, and the activity is more intense than ever. The cameras are on and recording the chilling moments when evil begins to terrorize young sisters Katie and Kristi for the first time.

programme.title: Pearl: An X-traordinary Origin Story
programme.desc: Trapped on her family's isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter, overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for the glamorous life she's seen in the movies, Pearl's temptations and repressions collide.

programme.title: MaXXXine

programme.title: All Hallows Eve Inferno
programme.desc: When a woman survives a horrific crash that leaves her paralyzed, her nightmare is far from over.

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: Wild Rebels
programme.desc: A retired race car driver, talked into going undercover by the police, joins a biker gang and must serve as the getaway car driver.

programme.title: MST3K Shorts

programme.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The Wild Wild World of Batwoman
programme.desc: In this lower-than-low budget film, Batwoman enlists her band of go-go dancing Batgirls to protect the Atomic Hearing Aid from the rotten Rat Fink.

programme.title: MST3K: Escape 2000

programme.title: Fall of Fame
programme.desc: Big swings, missed landings, and spectacular crashes remind us that the road to glory is paved with wipeouts.

programme.title: Fall of Fame
programme.desc: From flying gear to hard landings, these competitors show that sometimes the biggest hit comes after the play.

programme.title: FailArmy Trivia
programme.desc: Wicked questions meet wicked fails in this autumnal mash-up of mess-ups.

programme.title: Grandes Mitos

programme.title: Fronteras peligrosas de Latinoamerica

programme.title: Fronteras peligrosas de Latinoamerica

programme.title: Fronteras peligrosas de Latinoamerica

programme.title: Fronteras peligrosas de Latinoamerica

programme.title: Fronteras peligrosas de Latinoamerica
programme.desc: Un contrabandista intenta darse a la fuga en la frontera brasileña y termina colisionando su automóvil contra un móvil policial. Mientras que al caer la noche, los agentes aduaneros sorprenden a cambistas ilegales en la frontera de Ipiales.

programme.title: Fronteras peligrosas de Latinoamerica

programme.title: Fronteras peligrosas de Latinoamerica

programme.title: Fronteras peligrosas de Latinoamerica

programme.title: Fronteras peligrosas de Latinoamerica

programme.title: Fronteras peligrosas de Latinoamerica

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: A finales de los años ochenta, el FBI tuvo una batalla de inteligencia con un ladrón de bancos astuto. El ladrón hacía una planificación meticulosa, y sus crímenes los ejecutó con precisión militar.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses
programme.desc: En 1987, se descubrieron un cráneo humano y algunos huesos en un campamento de niños exploradores cerca de Farmington, Missouri. La reconstrucción facial ayuda a los investigadores en este caso.

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.title: Archivos Forenses

programme.desc: Comenzamos nuestro viaje en Arizona, el sexto estado más grande de los EE.UU, donde nos acercaremos lo más posible al espacio en el Museo Pima Air & Space, conoceremos el Parque Nacional del Bosque Petrificado y el increíble Gran Cañón.

programme.title: El Mundo Es Tuyo
programme.desc: Iniciaremos nuestro recorrido visitando Chamonix, una comuna francesa donde podremos deslizarnos en la nieve en las muchas zonas de esquí frente al valle.

programme.title: El Mundo Es Tuyo
programme.desc: Comenzaremos nuestro viaje por el Himalaya y visitaremos los muchos templos espirituales de Nepal. Trae tu equipo de escalar porque encontraremos las mejores vistas en los picos más altos del mundo.

programme.title: El Mundo Es Tuyo
programme.desc: Nuestro viaje comenzará en un Safari por el Desierto de Kalahari. Cruzaremos toda la extensión correspondiente a Botsuana para disfrutar de los hermosos paisajes de África.

programme.title: El Mundo Es Tuyo
programme.desc: Comenzamos nuestro viaje en las Islas Maltesas donde la aventura es abundante; nos hundiremos hasta las rodillas en la Laguna Azul, escalaremos una de las miles de rutas en la pared de un acantilado.

programme.title: El Mundo Es Tuyo
programme.desc: Comenzamos nuestro viaje en las monumentales Cataratas del Niágara, ubicadas entre Estados Unidos y Canadá. Iremos en un emocionante paseo en helicóptero por las Cataratas y para finalizar disfrutaremos unas deliciosas alas de búfalo.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter LT
programme.desc: Youpi se transforma y divide al grupo con su ataque. Morel deja que Shoot y Knuckle se encarguen de las cosas mientras se dirige al Rey.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter LT
programme.desc: El Rey se enfrenta con Netero y Zeno.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter LT
programme.desc: Knuckle aparece de repente ante Youpi para luchar contra él.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter LT
programme.desc: Las palabras crípticas de Zeno a Killua y Gon se vuelven claras cuando llegan a la torre.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter LT
programme.desc: Sintiendo la necesidad de darle un puñetazo a Youpi para vengar a su amigo Shoot, Knuckle decide enfrentarlo una vez más.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter LT
programme.desc: Ikalgo lee el mensaje oculto de Palm, que dice que ha ido al palacio y que asuma que está muerta si no responde antes del inicio de la misión.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter LT
programme.desc: Youpi está impresionado por las habilidades del equipo de exterminio y reconoce su fuerza.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter LT
programme.desc: Morel destruye el capullo ante él, pero como sospechaba, Pouf no está dentro.

programme.title: Hunter x Hunter LT
programme.desc: Gon espera a que Neferpitou termine de curar a Komugi con la Doctora Blythe, mientras Morel lucha contra Youpi.

programme.title: Heidi: Clara
programme.desc: A la llegada de Heidi a Frankfurt será compañera de una niña llamada Clara que esta en una silla de ruedas.

programme.title: Heidi: El campanario
programme.desc: Heidi quiere subir al campanario para ver si logra ver las montañas, desafortunadamente no puede pero encuentra 2 gatitos uno para ella y otro para Clara los cuales deben esconder de la señorita Rottenmeier.

programme.title: Heidi: La promesa
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier es alérgica a los gatos, pide a Sebastian que los ahogue y encierra a Heidi en el sotano como castigo. Clara ayuda a que Heidi escape para salvar a los gatitos.

programme.title: Heidi: El regreso de papá
programme.desc: Es impresionante el avance que a tenido Clara desde que llegó Heidi, Clara teme que su padre quiera expulsar a Heidi, asi que decide mostrarle ella misma que puede ir sola a la ciudad a comprar su pastel favorito.

programme.title: Heidi: Estudiando en casa
programme.desc: El maestro de Clara regresa de sus vacaciones, para su sorpresa Heidi aún no sabe leer ni escribir por lo que tendrán que separar a las dos amigas ya que su nivel escolar es diferente.

programme.title: Heidi: Preparando un espectáculo
programme.desc: La abuela de Clara llega a cambiar el ambiente de la casa, se da cuenta que el maestro es muy académico. Gracias a la obra que la abuela le enseña a Heidi ella aprender a leer, la abuela se encargará de la educación de las chicas.

programme.title: Heidi: En el parque
programme.desc: Heidi y Clara salen al parque, las chicas conocen a Rudy. Heidi y Rudy van corriendo jugando y Clara trata de alcanzarlos, lamentablemente Clara cae de su silla de ruedas, queda lastimada y Heidi está preocupada ya que a lo mejor Clara y no podrá caminar.

programme.title: Heidi: Clara se pone de pie
programme.desc: Despúes de su accidente Clara no quiere salir de su habitación. La abuela y Heidi intentan animarla pero no lo logran, en secreto Clara esta practicando para poder volver a caminar.

programme.title: Heidi: Cabras en la ciudad
programme.desc: Heidi y Clara dan una vuelta de nuevo por el parque, descubren que el parque hay cabras, pero la más bebé esta enferma. Heidi se la lleva a casa para curarla pero debe apresurarse antes de que regrese la señorita Rottenmeier.

programme.title: Heidi: La renuncia
programme.desc: La señorita Rottenmeier regresa y se da cuenta que Heidi tiene a una cabra bebé. Heidi decide irse a vivir con Rudy y tomar un tren para regresar a las montañas. Rottemeier le da una segunda oportunidad a Heidi.

programme.title: Heidi: Un árbol como refugio
programme.desc: Clara ya puede ponerse de pie sin ayuda de nadie. El señor Sesemann quiere adoptar a Heidi, Heidi se aterra de la situación pensando que ya nunca vovler a las montañas. El señor Sesseman entiende el miedo de Heidi y decide posponer la adopción.

programme.desc: Sasuke por fin alcanza a Gaara, Temari y Kankuro. Kankuro escapa con Gaara, dejando a Temari para que se enfrente a Sasuke.

programme.title: Naruto: Técnica Secreta Prohibida: Sello De La Parca De La Muerte
programme.desc: El enardecido combate entre el Hokage y Orochimaru continúa. Finalmente, el Hokage recurre a un jutsu que Orochimaru desconoce, el jutsu conocido como Sello de la Parca de la Muerte.

programme.title: Naruto: Increible Verdad: La Identidad De Gaara Emerge
programme.desc: Shino aparece mientras Sasuke y Kankuro combaten. Dejando que Shino se encargue de Kankuro, Sasuke se enfrenta a Gaara.

programme.title: Naruto: La Decisión De Sasuke… Llevada Al Límite
programme.desc: La mitad del cuerpo de Gaara se ha transformado y Sasuke continúa combatiendo con él.

programme.title: Naruto: El Asesino De La Noche De Luna
programme.desc: Cuando Naruto y Sakura alcanzan a Sasuke, este ha agotado sus fuerzas y se ha desplomado.

programme.title: Naruto: La Luz Contra La Oscuridad. Las Dos Caras De Gaara
programme.desc: Naruto está indefenso ante el inmenso poder de Gaara. A diferencia de Naruto, que manifiesta que pelea por sus compañeros, Gaara dice que él solo lucha por sí mismo.

programme.title: Naruto: El Manual Ninja De Naruto
programme.desc: Naruto está indefenso ante la fuerza abrumadora de Gaara. Sin embargo, después de ver a Sasuke arriesgándolo todo para salvarlos a él y a Sakura…

programme.title: Naruto: Más Allá Del Límite De La Oscuridad Y La Luz
programme.desc: Gaara utiliza su Jutsu de muerte falsa, que permite que el espíritu de la arena de su interior, Shukaku, muestre su verdadero poder.

programme.title: Naruto: El Tercer Hokage, Eternamente
programme.desc: Gaara y Naruto continúan combatiendo con todas sus fuerzas. Decidido a proteger a Sakura, Naruto ataca a Gaara una y otra vez.

programme.title: Naruto: El regreso del rocío matinal
programme.desc: Aunque el plan de Orochimaru para destruir la Aldea Escondida entre las Hojas se ha frustrado, los daños causados son muchos y el trabajo para hacer las reparaciones comienza rápidamente.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan intenta invitar a una chica a una cita, que resulta ser la hija del jefe de su padre, el Sr. Dawson, pero en el proceso, Kenan y Kel dejan un mensaje escandaloso en su buzón de mensajes.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan ha ahorrado suficiente dinero para comprar una nueva bicicleta justo a tiempo para Navidad, pero ¿gastará ese dinero solo para él? ¿O habrá un espacio en su corazón para el espíritu navideño?

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan entra en pánico cuando la directora de la escuela pide una reunión con él y sus padres. Pensando que hizo algo malo, decide contratar a dos actores para que hagan de sus padres durante la cita.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Es el Día de Acción de Gracias y el padre de Kenan ha preparado un pavo. Pero cuando nadie está en la cocina, Kel no puede resistir la tentación y se devora el pavo en cuestión de minutos. Ahora Kenan y Kel están en grandes problemas.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Hay una maestra sustituta en la clase y Kel está seguro de que ella está enamorada de Kenan. Kenan no le cree al principio, pero Kel es persistente y persuasivo. Comienza a convencer a Kenan de que puede tener razón.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel deciden saltarse un día de escuela y trabajo. Se hacen pasar por enfermos, pero pronto se encuentran en grandes problemas, cuando son atrapados en un robo de banco y terminan apareciendo en las noticias.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel están en el trabajo cuando un payaso de circo entra en Rigby’s y roba la tienda. Las cosas empeoran cuando el mismo payaso aparece más tarde en la fiesta de cumpleaños de Kyra, y los muchachos deciden entrar en acción.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel gana 64 millones de dólares en la lotería y quiere dividir el premio con su mejor amigo, Kenan. Parece que las cosas están saliendo bastante bien para ambos, hasta que Kel pierde el billete ganador.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan le apuesta a Kel que no puede estar una semana sin beber gaseosa de naranja, por lo que Kenan hará cualquier artimaña para que Kel pierda.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: La banda del Bandido Keith secuestra a Joey y lo llevan a una cueva secreta que tiene adentro un cementerio de duelos. Mientras Yugi y sus amigos lo buscan, Joey tiene que afrentarse a los monstruos zombi de el Bandido Keith.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El duelo contra el Bandido Keith le va muy mal a Joey. Hasta el último esfuerzo de Joey, su monstruo dichoso Mago del Tiempo, también le falla.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey y Yugi se enfrentan en un duelo contra los Hermanos Paradoja, unos eliminadores de duelistas en el servicio de Pegasus. Pero si no ganan, Yugi y Joey pierderan mucho más que el duelo.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Los Hermanos Paradoja convocan el monstruo todopoderoso, Guardián de la Puerta, ¡con el poder de reflejar todos los ataques que lanzan Yugi & Joey! No se sabe si Joey esta a ayudando a Yugi…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey y Yugi pelean con sus monstruos más poderosos, pero su fuerza no es nada contra Gate Guardian. Individualmente, Joey y Yugi no tienen chance, pero ahora ellos preparan para usar el poder más fuerte de todos, ¡la cooperación!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Para ganar el derecho de retar a Pegasus a un duelo, Kaiba tendrá que primermente vencer a Yugi y quitarle sus estrellas. ¡Ahora la muy anticipada revancha entre Kaiba Y Yugi comenzara!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba convoca Dragón de Ojos Azules Definitivo, el monstruo mas poderoso en el juego, ¡formado cuando se unen tres Dragones Blancos de Ojos Azules! Yugi ha perdido todos sus monstruos poderosos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi empieza a formar una estrategia para terminar con Dragón Blanco de Ojos Azules pero tiene que decidir entre ganando el duelo o salvarle la vida a Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi ha perdido sus estrellas y la posibilidad de rescatar a su abuelo. Se ha quedado en choque por lo que sucedió en el duelo con Kaiba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos llegan al castillo de Pegasus y descubren que Seto Kaiba duela contra Pegasus para poder rescatar a la alma de su hermano, Mokuba.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba no puede hacer nada contra la bajera Mundo Toon de Pegasus y el poder de su ojo del milenio, siendo humillado y derrotado en el duelo. Al ganar, Pegasus atrapa el alma de Kaiba en una carta, igual como Mokubah y el abuelo de Yugi.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que Pokemon GO comenzó como una simple broma?. Encendemos motores para repasar la cronología de Mario Kart. Y te hablaremos de UnMetal, un juego al que, si eres fan de Metal Gear.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Nintendo solo hace videojuegos, ¿cierto? ¡Falso!, la empresa japonesa ha tenido otros negocios diferentes desde su fundación, y en Expansion Pack te lo contamos. Repasamos la legendaria vida de Master Chief. Además, la retroreseña de Super Metroid.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Los esports continúan creciendo cada vez más, en Expansion Pack te hablaremos al respecto. Platicamos acerca de Metal: Hellsinger, un juego ideal si lo tuyo es la acción frenética y el heavy metal; y nos ponemos mitológicos para repasar God of War.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Érase una vez, un evento de videojuegos tan grande, que todo el mundo quería estar en él nos referimos al E3, y en Expansion Pack nos pondremos nostálgicos para recordar cómo era este show. Como broche de oro, honraremos obra de Shigeru Miyamoto.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este Expansion Pack te presentaremos un top dedicado a algunas de las interpretaciones más memorables. Repasaremos la evolución de una de las sagas más emblemáticas de Xbox: Gears of War y te contaremos todo acerca del origen de adorable Kirby.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este episodio de Expansion Pack, te diremos todo lo que debes saber acerca de la Gamescom, el evento de videojuegos más grande de Europa. Veremos a detalle la trayectoria de Lara Croft; y viajaremos al pasado para recordar al legendario Dino Crisis.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Es hora de iniciar un nuevo nivel de Expansion Pack, conoceremos cómo surge la ESRB, también veremos la evolución de la legendaria saga “Príncipe de Persia”, y echaremos un vistazo a esos juegos que fueron tan buenos que cambiaron a su género.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Los Game Awards, en Expansion Pack te volverás experto en uno de los eventos más importantes para el gaming, recordaremos al maravilloso “Pilot Wings 64”, y reconoceremos a los maestros de la música en los videojuegos.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: ¿Conoces las diferencias ente Remaster, Remake y Reboot? En este episodio de Expansion Pack te las contamos. Veremos cómo “Street Fighter”, ha cambiado con el paso de los años; y sentimos el terror con las creepypastas más famosas en videojuegos.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡Derriben la Giant Jack! La última esperanza de huida
programme.desc: A Nami se le ocurre una idea para intentar llegar hasta el arca de Enel, que se está alejando cada vez más. La solución pasa por cortar la Giant Jack, así que todos los que están abajo harán todo lo posible por ayudar.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡Un milagro en la tierra de Dios! La canción de amor que llegó a los ángeles
programme.desc: Luffy finalmente consigue llegar hasta el Arca Maxim para enfrentarse a Enel y acabar con los problemas de una vez por todas.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡El final de la batalla! La orgullosa fantasía resuena a lo lejos.
programme.desc: Armado de valor, Luffy parece que ha logrado derrotar a Enel y el Arca Maxim se hunde entre las nubes. Es hora de acabar con el conflicto de hace 400 años y enterrar el hacha de guerra.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡Llegué hasta aquí! La historia que cuenta el Poneglyph
programme.desc: Tras la celebración por la victoria, quedaba pendiente un asunto muy importante que resolver antes de marcharse al Mar Azul: el oro de Shandora, así que los piratas deciden robarlo y huir con él.

programme.title: One Piece - Sky Island Saga: ¡Hacia el Mar Azul! Un final lleno de sentimientos
programme.desc: Una vez que salieron huyendo con el oro, se reúnen nuevamente con Conis para que les indique dónde está Cloud End, el lugar desde el que podrán regresar al Mar Azul.

programme.title: La Fuente de la Vida

programme.title: Heidi: Un árbol como refugio
programme.desc: Clara ya puede ponerse de pie sin ayuda de nadie. El señor Sesemann quiere adoptar a Heidi, Heidi se aterra de la situación pensando que ya nunca vovler a las montañas. El señor Sesseman entiende el miedo de Heidi y decide posponer la adopción.

programme.title: Heidi: El fantasma
programme.desc: Heidi no puede dormir, extraña su vida en las montañas. Todos en la casa piensan que se trata de un fantasma pero en realidad es Heidi que extraña su vida anterior. Clara invita al abuelo a pasar unos días en Frankfurt.

programme.title: Heidi: La carta
programme.desc: Heidi se enferma al enterarse de que su tía nunca le mando la carta al abuelo, Clara está angustiada y pide que dejen a Heidi regresar a las montañas. Finalmente Heidi irá de regreso y mandan la carta pero la carta se pierde en el camino.

programme.title: Heidi: De regreso en Dörfli
programme.desc: Heidi toma el tren de vuelta a las montañas, el abuelo no recibe la carta y emprende un viaje a Mayenfeld, Heidi hará todo lo posible para llegar con su abuelo y pedirle que regrese a las montañas.

programme.title: Heidi: Una nueva cabra en el rebaño
programme.desc: Heidi esta feliz de regresar de nuevo a la montaña con Pedro y las cabras. Karl se mete en un problema y Pedro tiene que acudir a su rescate, Heidi se queda sola con las cabras con la sorpresa de que la cabra embarazada esta a punto de dar a luz.

programme.title: Heidi: La estatua rota
programme.desc: Heidi y el abuelo se mudan a la mansión para que Heidi pueda continuar sus estudios. Los Keller se enojan por esta situación y se niegan a venderle suministros al abuelo.

programme.title: Heidi: El prendedor
programme.desc: Pedro y su abuela no tienen suficiente dinero, Heidi encuentra el broche de su abuela, una reliquia que los puede ayudar a salir de este problema.

programme.title: Heidi: Prueba escolar
programme.desc: El profesor organizar una prueba para finalizar el periodo, Theresa esta celosa de que Heidi esta ayudando a Pedro a ser buen estudiante, en venganza abre el recinto de las cabras para que Pedro no pueda llegar a la prueba a tiempo.

programme.title: Heidi: La búsqueda del tesoro
programme.desc: El Sr Traber se mudará a otra ciudad pero se lleva consigo a Karl, Theresa tiene sentimientos por él. Heidi la empujara a que confiese sus sentimientos por el antes de que se vaya.

programme.title: Heidi: La hora de las cabras
programme.desc: Por fin llega Clara y la señorita Rottenmeier a visitar a Heidi, Clara y Heidi quieren pasar el mayor tiempo juntas por lo que deben convencer a la señorita Rottenmeier de que vivan juntos en las cabañas en la montaña.

programme.desc: Aunque el plan de Orochimaru para destruir la Aldea Escondida entre las Hojas se ha frustrado, los daños causados son muchos y el trabajo para hacer las reparaciones comienza rápidamente.

programme.title: Naruto: Ojo por ojo, Sharingan contra Sharingan
programme.desc: Kakashi llega justo a tiempo para ayudar a Asuma y Kurenai. Itachi también se une al combate. ¡La batalla definitiva entre los dos poseedores de Sharingan comienza!

programme.title: Naruto: Jiraiya: El Desastre Potencial De Naruto
programme.desc: Jiraiya y Naruto parten para encontrar a Tsunade, una de los legendarios Sannin. Jiraiya tiene dos propósitos: proteger a Naruto de las garras de la misteriosa organización Akatsuki y entrenar a su aprendiz.

programme.title: Naruto: El Rugir Del Chidori: Los Hermanos Se Enfrentan
programme.desc: Decidido a enfrentarse a Itachi, Sasuke se dirige rápidamente al lugar donde se aloja Naruto. De camino, los recuerdos trágicos de su pasado inundan su mente.

programme.title: Naruto: Odio Entre Los Uchiha: El Último Del Clan
programme.desc: Jiraiya rescata a Naruto de Kisame justo a tiempo. No hay duda de que Itachi y la organización Akatsuki van tras Naruto para obtener el poder del Zorro de las Nueve Colas.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Un Nuevo Entrenamiento Comienza! ¡Voy A Ser Fuerte!
programme.desc: Con profundas heridas físicas y mentales, Sasuke es transportado a la Aldea Escondida entre las Hojas por Guy. Ojalá la especialista médica, Tsunade, estuviera allí…

programme.title: Naruto: Sigue Entrenando… Hay Que Reventar El Globo De Agua
programme.desc: Naruto por fin comienza su entrenamiento con Jiraiya. La técnica que Naruto aprenderá es la principal del Cuarto Hokage, una técnica que incluso un genio como él tardó tres años en dominar.

programme.title: Naruto: El punto de enfoque, la marca de la Hoja
programme.desc: Naruto consigue completar el primer paso de su entrenamiento. Pero el siguiente paso, hacer que una bola de goma explote con chakra, resulta extremadamente difícil.

programme.title: Naruto: Una elección imposible: El dolor del corazón de Tsunade
programme.desc: Orochimaru y Kabuto aparecen de repente ante Tsunade y Shizune, que están haciendo turismo. Orochimaru, herido por el Sello de la Parca de la Muerte del Tercer Hokage, le pide a la antigua Sannin que utilice sus conocimientos médicos para ayudarlo.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Imperdonable! ¡Una total falta de respeto!
programme.desc: A cambio de haberle curado los brazos, Orochimaru ofrece a Tsunade devolver la vida a su hermano menor Nawaki y a Dan, su amado.
